results.snippet: Modern enterprise AI governance mandates post-hoc audit trails for tool-calling agents. Key controls include continuous scope monitoring, sensitive PII entity redaction, and factual groundedness verification against observable tool outputs.

results.title: Enterprise Cloud Architecture for Serverless Audit Trails
